title: Trigger instance
description: One received event as the platform records it. Created by the rules engine from a dispatch message, then served over the REST API.

id.description: Document id, assigned by the store when the rules engine creates the record.

trigger.description: Reference to the trigger that fired, in pack.name form.

payload.description: The event as it arrived. Rule criteria are evaluated against these fields; the shape belongs to the pack that registered the trigger type.

occurrence-time.description: When the engine took the message off the queue, not when the world event happened. Wire key: occurrence_time.

status.description: What the platform did with the event. The failure value is snake_case on the wire and is written here as it is sent.
